name: Specialized Crux 10r frameset
why_interesting: The 10r frameset is the lower-priced official mainland route into a custom Crux build while retaining the family's wide-clearance race focus.
missing: Exact current generation, color and included hardware

facts.frame_material: FACT 10r carbon frame with S-Works FACT carbon fork; exact fiber grade and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: Rider First Engineered carbon frame with threaded bottom bracket, 12×142 mm thru-axle, flat-mount disc and UDH
facts.stiffness_evidence: A current exact-FACT-10r GRX build review describes the frame as rigid and reactive with stable, precise handling; qualitative editorial ride evidence only, not a measured frameset result

source_note: The China catalog lists the Crux 10r frameset at ¥20,990. Family specifications remain separate from exact-generation confirmation; stock and final dealer checkout were not tested.
